Vistadome Train Service Limited During Amarnath Yatra

The Vistadome Special train service in Kashmir will operate exclusively between Banihal and Budgam stations. This restriction is in place for the duration of the Amarnath Yatra pilgrimage season. The service aims to cater to pilgrims during this period.
